%1$s d iminig ilelli yettwabnan seg tengalt n uɣbalu yeldin n Firefox d GeckoView n Mozilla. Ur yettwaxdem ara, ur yettwaqbel ara, ur yettwaɛiwen ara sɣur Mozilla. Firefox d tacreḍt yettwasejlen n Mozilla Foundation g Marikan d tmura-nniḍen.
Yiwet n tebdart n tigawin, d wanda i d-tettban yal yiwet

Tigawin akkʷ llant g yiwet n tebdart, ula d tid i ternuḍ s yiman-ik. Fren anda i d-tettban yal yiwet: ɣef iseksal yessersen, iseksal ur nesrusi ara d ikuramen, g ufeggag n iseksal yettwafernen, g Umuɣ Ugar akked g ufeggag n tigawin ddaw tsna. Tigawin ɣef ukaram ttawḍent ɣer yal aseksel yellan deg-s.
Fren ar %1$d ibuṭunen i izirigen n ikuramen. Ad xedmen ɣef yal aseksel g ukaram akked ikuramen yellan deg-s.

Fren tigawin i d-ittbanen ddaw tsna tagejdant mi ara teṭṭfeḍ akud ɣezzifen akken ad tferneḍ iseksal, ayen ilaqen neɣ ikuramen. Tigawt tettban kan ma tezmer ad texdem ɣef wayen yettwafernen.

Iseksal g usenduq ṭṭfen ibiskwit-nsen d yisefka n usmel-nsen. Ṭṭef akud ɣezzifen ɣef Aseksel Amaynu ɣef tsna tagejdant akken ad terẓmeḍ aseksel g usenduq, neɣ efk asenduq i umkan n umahil akkʷ seg umuɣ-ines.
Ibiskwit-is d yisefka n usmel-is ttwakksen. Fren d acu ara yeḍrun i iseksal-is.

Assuter yettwazen yiwet n tikkelt i yal aseksel i deg tettedu tigawt. Kan tiririt 2xx ttwaḥsaben d lawan; imesdayen ur ttwaḍfaren ara ttwaḥsaben d urrif. Ibiskwit ur ttwaznen ara. Azalen ttwajerrden s URL deg URL d tfekka n tferkit, ttwasellken deg tfekka JSON neɣ XML.
Sit ɣef umedya akken ad taččareḍ urtan sennig. Sakin err aqeddac-ik g umkan n example.com, akked tsura-k d yisulayen g umkan n iqermuden s tsedlisin tibararin.

Aseksel yeṭṭsen yesserraḥ takatut-is, syin yessali-d tasna-s tikkelt-nniḍen mi ara t-terẓmeḍ. Aseksel i tettwaliḍ, win i s-d-yezgan g tmuɣli tabḍant, akked iseksal i d-yessuffuɣen ameslaw neɣ i yesseqdacen takamiṛat neɣ asawaḍ ur ṭṭsen ara. Ma yesra Android takatut mi ara yili Dejavu g ugilal, iseksal akkʷ ad ṭṭsen, ala sin i tesseqdceḍ taneggarut.
